summary: The candidate is correct. Each square atom is the convex average of four centroid source points and hence lies in the mixed-integer body. For any halfspace containing an atom, orienting the label to one contained tagged source occurrence charges its mass to the accepted occurrence ledger; the centroid halfspace bound and D_y <= a_y then give the claimed halfspace domination, including boundary, loop, repeated-source, coincident-atom, and improper-halfspace cases. The mass identity is exact, and when the cloud is nonzero the accepted dominated-measure residual theorem applies with exactly the stated intrinsic ranks and yields the asserted depth bounds.
